name: open-pdf-studio
description: A free, open-source PDF annotation editor built with Tauri

scripts.predev: npm run prepare:native-runtime && cargo build -p pdfium-worker
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:native-runtime && cargo build --release -p pdfium-worker
scripts.test: npm run test:ocr && npm run test:unit && npm run test:quality
scripts.test:ocr-editing-foundation: npm run test:ocr-editing-foundation:unit && npm run test:ocr-editing-foundation:visual && npm run test:ocr-editing-foundation:pdfium
scripts.test:ocr: node --test js/ocr/contracts/v1.test.mjs js/ocr/contracts/production.test.mjs js/ocr/searchable-layer.test.mjs js/ocr/review-model.test.mjs js/ocr/application-controller.test.mjs js/ocr/workflow-service.test.mjs js/ocr/cache.test.mjs js/ocr/model-state.test.mjs js/ocr/engine.test.mjs js/ocr/child-runner.test.mjs js/ocr/paddleocr/adapter.test.mjs js/ocr/paddleocr/postprocess.test.mjs js/ocr/pdf-writer-proof.test.mjs js/ocr/pdf-persistence.test.mjs scripts/ocr-adversarial-resource-limits.test.mjs scripts/ocr-assets.test.mjs scripts/evaluate-ocr-phase-a-reports.test.mjs scripts/evaluate-ocr-phase-a-macos-report.test.mjs scripts/ocr-process-attribution.test.mjs scripts/ocr-build-kind.test.mjs scripts/ocr-quality-benchmark.test.mjs
scripts.test:ocr-ui:macos: node scripts/test-ocr-searchable-layer-macos.mjs && node scripts/test-ocr-recognition-dialog-macos.mjs && node scripts/test-ocr-progress-macos.mjs && node scripts/test-ocr-review-macos.mjs && node scripts/test-ocr-production-workflow-macos.mjs
scripts.test:ocr-edit-regions: npm run test:ocr-edit-regions:unit && npm run test:ocr-edit-regions:visual && npm run test:ocr-edit-regions:pdfium && npm run test:ocr-edit-regions:macos
scripts.test:ocr-reflow: npm run test:ocr-reflow:unit && npm run test:ocr-reflow:visual && npm run test:ocr-reflow:pdfium && npm run test:ocr-reflow:macos
scripts.test:ocr-release-hardening:macos: npm run test:ocr-release-hardening:artifact && npm run test:ocr-release-hardening:filesystem
scripts.test:ocr-release-qualification:macos: npm run test:ocr-adversarial:unit && npm run test:ocr-adversarial:macos && npm run test:ocr-production-100-page:macos
scripts.test:ocr-packaged:macos:stages: npm run test:ocr-ui:macos && npm run test:ocr-save:macos && npm run test:ocr-edit-single-line:macos && npm run test:ocr-edit-regions:macos && npm run test:ocr-reflow:macos && npm run test:ocr-release-hardening:macos && npm run test:ocr-release-qualification:macos
scripts.test:ocr-packaged:macos: OPEN_PDF_STUDIO_PACKAGED_APP='../target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/macos/Open PDF Studio.app/Contents/MacOS/open-pdf-studio' OPEN_PDF_STUDIO_PACKAGED_APP_BUNDLE='../target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/macos/Open PDF Studio.app' npm run test:ocr-packaged:macos:stages
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/test-nen-ifc-map.mjs scripts/test-systeemraster.mjs scripts/font-catalog.test.mjs js/drafting/tekeningtype.test.mjs js/annotations/editable-numbers.test.mjs js/symbols/templates/wapeningskorf.test.mjs js/pdf/canvas-dpr.test.mjs js/pdf/document-metadata.test.mjs js/pdf/pdf-preload-controller.test.mjs js/pdf/progressive-render.test.mjs js/pdf/resource-limits.test.mjs js/pdf/tile-coverage.test.mjs js/quantities/engine.test.mjs js/quantities/schedule-image.test.mjs js/quantities/takeoff.test.mjs js/text/native-expandable-layout.test.mjs js/text/native-text-blocks.test.mjs js/text/native-text-provenance.test.mjs js/text/owned-edit-manifest.test.mjs js/text/owned-text-edit-targets.test.mjs js/text/rich-text.test.mjs js/text/text-edit-selection.test.mjs js/text/text-edit-appearance.test.mjs js/text/text-edit-contrast.test.mjs js/tools/embedded-image-parser.test.mjs
scripts.test:quality: node --test scripts/native-runtime.test.mjs scripts/release-config.test.mjs scripts/linux-release-config.test.mjs scripts/pdfium-sidecar.test.mjs scripts/square-image-annotation.test.mjs
